Celebrate Diwali with an evening honoring the triumph of good over evil, knowledge over ignorance, and light over darkness.

About this Event

🎆 Join the Harvard Chan South Asia Students Association for Jashn-e-Diwali!
🎇Celebrate Diwali, the Festival of Lights, with an evening honoring the triumph of good over evil, knowledge over ignorance, and light over darkness.
✨ Enjoy an unforgettable evening filled with:
🎶 Music & Dancing
🍛 Delicious South Asian Food
🎲 Fun Activities, including Trivia and DIY Mehndi
Spouses, partners, and children are warmly welcome! Come together with friends and family to celebrate the joy, culture, and traditions of Diwali.
📅 Event Date: Thursday, November 5, 2026, from 7–10 PM
📍 Location: Vanderbilt JBM Hall – Student Lounge
💫 Ticket Prices:
🎟 Early Bird Ticket: $13 (available for one week)🧑‍🎓 Regular Harvard Chan Student Ticket: $15👥 Regular Non-Chan Student / Professor Ticket: $18✨ We can't wait to celebrate with you at Jashn-e-Diwali! ✨
